item: T4 35-column projection manifest: F3 ground-truth manifest filtered to the columns constructible from the existing F2 ZC 2025-01 fixture builds by column selection/renaming only
working_resolution_R3: R3. 35-column: accepted as a documented-unverifiable assumption (basis: F3 manifest 9/9 agreement). T4 is unblocked by this.
projection_rule: Column selection/renaming ONLY. A target column is 'direct' on exact name match in the 87-column build output, 'mapped-from:<name>' only where the construction of the intermediate was verified identical to phase7's construction (source column, aggregation, window), else UNCONSTRUCTIBLE. No feature was constructed.
canonical_serialization: df.to_csv(index=False, float_format="%.12g"), sha256 over utf-8 bytes (same convention as f2/run_fixture.py lines 28-31)

projected_columns.projection_note: MEASURED FACT (contaminated run1): vwap_distance holds 243,000 NaN of 338,159 rows (71.9%), scattered (positions 0-3024 NaN, first non-NaN at 3025, NaN again at the tail), while the merged+ffilled 'vwap' intermediate holds 0 NaN and mid_price holds 0 zeros/NaN. Consistent with the variable 'mid' (defined BEFORE the trades merge, on the hour-filtered index that was never reset: fixture line 189/phase7 line 145 filter without reset_index; mid at fixture line 193/phase7 line 149) being index-ALIGNED against the post-merge RangeIndex frame at assignment (fixture line 261/phase7 line 243; merge resets the index at fixture line 251/phase7 line 231). The construction text and ordering are IDENTICAL in both scripts, so this is a shared property of both builders, not a fixture divergence; projection identity is unaffected. Reported for author review.

unconstructible_columns.name: book_imbalance_ratio
unconstructible_columns.note: Not in the 45-set; new classification. Pure function of two contemporaneous leak sources - inherits, does not independently leak.
unconstructible_columns.reason: phase7_l2_sim.py lines 188-189 construct it: 'snap["book_imbalance_ratio"] = (snap["total_bid_depth"] /\n                                     snap["total_ask_depth"].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(1.0)'. The build output contains a column named 'book_imbalance', but it is a RAW snapshot-parquet pass-through (phase5_ml_fixture.py never constructs or touches it; it appears in the builder only inside the lag-exemption set); its construction inside the snapshot builder is not verifiable from the fixture code, so exact-construction equivalence CANNOT be verified => NOT mappable. Additionally, 'book_imbalance' is lag-EXEMPT in the corrected build (raw_book_cols, fixture.py lines 43-47 / phase7_l2_sim.py lines 268-272) whereas phase7's book_imbalance_ratio IS lagged at line 276 - different lag treatment even if values coincided. Constructing the ratio from total depths is prohibited.
